answer: Quick check first — back in December you moved your pay and bills to BNZ for the offset mortgage, and said Wise would just hold a small balance for travel spending. Has your pay gone back to landing in Wise? If it has, Wise Jars are the tool: set up one jar for rent and one for bills, and have the incoming USD converted to NZD on arrival and swept into them so only the leftover sits in your spendable balance. If BNZ is still your main account, you'd be better off doing the rent/bills split there and keeping Wise for travel and USD conversion.
